_comment: Template for ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Copy, fill in secrets, chmod 600. NEVER commit the real file.

_deny_rationale.exec: Shell access is not needed for this workload. Denying it removes the highest-severity outcome of a successful prompt injection.
_deny_rationale.gateway: Blocks the agent from modifying its own configuration or security posture.
_deny_rationale.message: THE CRITICAL ONE. Without it the agent physically cannot contact a seller, buyer, heir, or third party. Human-in-the-loop stops being a policy the model might reason around and becomes an architectural fact. Do not re-enable this for a demo.

_note_on_exec: The parish sweep and underwrite scripts are Python. With exec denied, the agent cannot run them directly -- run them via cron (see cron/jobs.json) writing to deals/_inbox/, which the agent reads with the filesystem MCP. This is deliberate: scheduled deterministic jobs do not need agent shell access.
_model_ids_note: Model identifiers go stale. Verify against current Anthropic documentation at deployment rather than trusting this file.
